detail.title: Medical suction pump
detail.abstract: A medical suction pump, comprising: a pump housing (1, 8); a pump assembly (6) arranged in the pump housing (1, 8) for generating a negative pressure; and means for sound insulation. The device for sound insulation has at least two elastic supports (51, 52) for elastically holding the pump assembly (6) relative to the pump housing (1, 8), wherein the supports (51, 52) are arranged at a distance from one another. The suction pump according to the invention enables optimum sound insulation due to the flexible mounting.
